title: Thick smoke emanates from Delhi's North Block, six fire tenders on site
description:
Thick smoke was seen billowing from the Union secretariat's North Block here on Monday, prompting authorities to rush six fire tenders to the spot, an official said.
A police officer said some repair work was underway at the building, which might have led to a minor fire.
No casualty has been reported so far.
Delhi Fire Services received a call at 11.10 am reporting smoke emanating from the building, following which six fire tenders were dispatched, the official said.
